rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something happened or was true by a specified time.

example.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 sik6 zo2 faan6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when “already” expresses surprise that something is happening so soon, often with 就 in the larger sentence.

example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 laa3
